contract: Bounded correlated join over a declared set of branch identities. accept/2 validates each core/envelope DeliveryResult, attributes it through a configured {:field, path} branch_key (correlation_id, attempt_id or a declared value field — never arrival position), and records first-wins branch outcomes: completed→fulfilled, rejected/failed→failed, timed_out→timed_out, unknown→unavailable. mark_lost/3 records first-class :timed_out/:killed/:unavailable losses, not synthetic results. decision/2 is a pure {join, outcome} transition over pending/all/partial/failed/expired; expiry converts pending branches to :missing and late branches to :timed_out and closes. Post-deadline and post-close input is recorded late, never merged; on-time duplicates are counted and differing outcome/value digests mark the branch conflicted. State is a plain map bounded by declared count and per-result encoded size, retained redacted (SHA-256 value_digest, never payloads) for caller persistence. Elzoo.Aggregation.Runner fans out declared {branch_id, fun} pairs once under an injected Task.Supervisor: exceptions and invalid returns become synthetic failed results, undispatchable starts become rejected/not_dispatched, join-refused results become :unavailable losses, and the deadline marks survivors :timed_out. Durable fan-out, sagas, scheduling, retries and Reactor are out of scope.
limits: Volatile only: no durable join state, exactly-once branch execution, cross-branch ordering, workflow timers, saga semantics, branch retry policy, provider adoption, Reactor, ordered/streaming join, payload aggregation or cross-join queries.
A timeout or loss records that branch evidence is unreadable or the branch was killed; it never proves an external branch did not run.
:missing means no evidence ever arrived for the branch; it is distinct from a recorded :unavailable loss or a zero/empty outcome.
Runner branch keys must be correlation_id/attempt_id-rooted so synthetic failure results carry identity; value-rooted joins are refused by the runner.
State bounds count declared branches and encoded result bytes, not retained memory of caller-held funs; the now clock port is a function value inside the plain-map state.
Telemetry is planned: only bounded decision/outcome events without payloads could be added later; snapshot/1 is inspection, not monitoring.

grounding.claim: Every accepted result passes Elzoo.Envelope.validate_result/1 — the pinned Cure DeliveryResult schema — before identity extraction or merge; malformed input is :invalid_result without mutation. Construction validates branch_key shape, bounds and deadline.

Named scenarios: declaration/config refusal, all outcome mappings, three identity carriers, refusal without mutation, oversize bound, late/expired/closed transitions, duplicate/conflict/loss records, arrival-order independence, plain-map round-trip, payload non-retention, corrupt-state and no-env-read audits. Finite evidence, not proofs.

Named scenarios over real Task.Supervisor tasks: success join, exception→failed, invalid return→failed, explicit failed result, deadline kill→timed_out, exactly-once no-retry, declaration refusals and value-key refusal. Finite evidence, not proofs.
Relies on pinned Cure compiler/kernel through the core/envelope dependency for DeliveryResult schema validation; not a local proof.
Relies on pinned Elixir/OTP Task.Supervisor async_nolink/:brutal_kill, GenServer and :crypto SHA-256 semantics; OTP stop is not business cancellation.
Caller owns branch funs, the Task.Supervisor, persistence of the plain-map join state and any instrumentation; volatile runner state lost on restart permits duplicate branch execution.

telemetry.contract: No telemetry events supplied; Runner.snapshot/1 is test-observed inspection, not monitoring. Any future events carry branch ids, statuses and counts only — never payloads.

config.contract: Construction-time branch_key, deadline_unix_ms, max_result_bytes, max_branches and now validated by new/2 and fixed in join state; runner options validated at start_link; no ambient configuration or hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: No business pause, drain, recovery or durable receipts; OTP stop of the runner is not business cancellation.
